accessible_backend_inventory.selection_contract: Largest currently accessible operational non-simulator usable-qubit count; ties ordered by pending jobs then backend name; scoped to pinned Open/free instance, not worldwide hardware maximum.

conclusion.global_zero_cause_directly_observed: No complete 156-zero outcome occurred in any of three 1024-shot measurements. All measured diagonals are also zero, although their ideal noiseless compute-uncompute value is one. This invalidates use of these raw values as a useful fidelity kernel.
conclusion.local_diagnostics_scope: Marginal p0 and Z expectations describe the output of each pairwise overlap circuit. They are not single-state molecular feature expectations.
conclusion.not_recoverable_from_old_counts: Single-state U(x)|0> X/Y/Z projected features, or X/Y expectations, cannot be inferred from these pairwise Z-basis overlap counts. A projected-state kernel requires separately specified circuits and new measurements; old data are not relabelled or substituted.
conclusion.physical_cause_status: Noise/readout/circuit execution errors are consistent with distorted diagonals and many measured ones, but this result alone cannot isolate their contributions or prove an implementation error absent. Finite-shot global-event rarity is observed; the true probability is not proven exactly zero.

diagonal_comparison.interpretation: Descriptive differences from one 1024-shot result per pair; no uncertainty-adjusted efficacy, separability or quantum-advantage claim.

independent_sidecar_validation.zero_probability_95_interval: Two-sided Wilson interval, finite-shot estimate; not a proof of exact-zero true probability.

measurement_contract: Z-basis measurement after compute-uncompute U(y)^dagger U(x); all-zero bitstring estimate of global overlap probability.
